message: a bound `aria-busy` on the `<div>` above it sets the live region of `warning` otherwise than its role does
$reason: A warning part inside a wrapper whose `aria-busy` an expression writes, the shape the library's README gives for a region that waits. In the state where it gives `'true'` Firefox 158 hands the part `container-busy="true"` (measured on 2026-10-27) and NVDA drops the warning's events; its value is not in the template, so it is refused as a bound role is, rather than read. Point 7 read nothing above the part but what may hide it, and passed it.
